_readme: Business settings. Leave a value as an empty string or null when it has not been confirmed - the site hides or labels anything that is missing.
name: The Sentinel Syndicate
description: A Kenyan racehorse syndicate offering shared ownership of thoroughbred racehorses. Explore available horses, ownership tiers and membership.
footerBlurb: Shared racehorse ownership in Kenya. People, horses, opportunity - held to a higher standard.

contact.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to enquire about ownership with The Sentinel Syndicate.

forms._readme: Enquiries are delivered by Web3Forms (https://web3forms.com). Create a free access key for partner@sentinelsyndicate.com and paste it below. Until a key is set, forms will NOT report success - visitors are shown direct contact options instead.

analytics._readme: Optional. Add a Google Analytics 4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX). Analytics only loads after a visitor accepts the consent banner, and the banner only appears when an ID is set.

budgetRanges._readme: Options shown in the 'Ownership budget' field. Prices were supplied in USD; add KES ranges here once confirmed.
options: USD 10,000 or more (10% ownership and above)
I would prefer to discuss this

_showSampleHorsesNote: Sample horses exist only to preview the design. Set to false once real horses are added to horses.json, or to show the 'no current listings' enquiry panel instead.
